text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from sorting emails to checking data. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees save time and focus on more important work. However, AI does not replace people completely. Human-AI collaboration is becoming common, where workers use smart systems to make better decisions and solve problems faster. This brings job changes too. Some roles disappear, but new ones appear, and workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI can make workplaces more efficient if people are ready to adapt and work alongside it.
